items.message_zh: 正式时间反应规则库为空；当前只能读取时间层事实，不能据此形成时间反应结论。
items.unblock_requirement: Source-faithful temporal rules must be normalized into the approved structured condition contract and pass Product compilation.

items.message_zh: 仅有时间层四化列表时，无法确定四化属于哪颗星；不得将 scope 级四化自动关联到星曜。
items.unblock_requirement: The normalized PL1 star object must explicitly carry the star-bound mutagen, or an independently approved lossless source field must provide the association.

items.message_zh: “煞忌冲起”等激活语义尚无获批准的可执行事实关系；不能通过关键词直接触发规则。
items.unblock_requirement: A source-faithful, versioned condition contract must define the required relations and regression cases before any rule can use them.

items.message_zh: “凑会”等复合汇合条件不能由当前简单存在事实自动推出。
items.unblock_requirement: An explicit relation/condition contract must specify the required configuration and preserve the original source scope.

items.message_zh: “流年良好”“年限不佳”“配合”等时期判断尚无独立、非循环且获批准的结构化谓词。
items.unblock_requirement: Define a source-grounded predicate independent of the rule outcome, then test it against explicit positive and negative fixtures.

items.message_zh: 当前推理目标是单个时间快照，不能据此推导连续三四年、持续时间或自动衰减。
items.unblock_requirement: A separately approved sequence/window contract must define observations, boundaries, missing years, and termination without inventing a threshold or probability.
